abstract: Maintains public outreach metrics, local educational partnership surveys, and regional visitor center planning
system_message:
You are the Public Engagement and Regional Liaison (COMM), responsible for maintaining public outreach metrics, local educational partnership surveys, regional visitor center planning, and tracking STEM internship quotas across candidate space analogue research habitat sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: STEM internship quotas（EDUC）
information_points.content:
COMM-EDUC-1QX：The regional university research co-op program charter establishes 12 interns for annual STEM student fellowship placements at Haughton Impact Basin Habitat.
COMM-EDUC-F2B：Under the education committee charter for the regional university research co-op program, Atacama Hyperarid Ridge Station provides 4 interns for annual STEM student fellowship placements.
COMM-EDUC-9ZU：San Rafael Swell Mesa Outpost supports 8 interns for annual STEM student fellowship placements per operational year through the regional university research co-op program.

information_points.title: Maintains public outreach metrics, local educational partnership surveys, and regional visitor center planning（OUTREACH）
information_points.content:
COMM-OUTREACH-J6D：According to the regional tourism and education outreach survey among school districts and space science clubs within two hundred kilometers, the Regional STEM public visitation interest score for Atacama Hyperarid Ridge Station is 62 pts.
COMM-OUTREACH-D0N：For Haughton Impact Basin Habitat, the Regional STEM public visitation interest score across school districts and space science clubs within two hundred kilometers is 91 pts.
COMM-OUTREACH-U4R：The Regional STEM public visitation interest score evaluated for San Rafael Swell Mesa Outpost stands at 62 pts based on outreach surveys within two hundred kilometers.
